description: Museum Dakota standing at the entrance to the village of Otok pri Metliki; commemorates the partisan airfield code-named Piccadilly Hope where Allied aircraft landed supplies and evacuated wounded and civilians from liberated Bela krajina in 1944-45; the neighbouring Krasinec strip was Piccadilly Hope A; annual „Vranov let“ ceremonies are held at the aircraft; no serial published and there is no evidence this particular airframe ever used the strip; slovene sources call it both DC-3 and C-47
aliases: DC3; DC-3; C-47; C47; Dakota; Piccadilly Hope
